summary: You take PSYCH 207, four of the five core courses and PSYCH 251, each core and methods course letter graded with a B- or better, plus one more statistics course and 12 advanced units (or a PhD minor) that you move in by hand; letter-graded advanced units need a B- or better. Teaching, the yearly IDP meeting, the First Year Project and committee meetings, candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation are checked by hand.

i1gQ2r7J.why: "Students must complete four core courses from each of the different areas of the Psychology department ... students are encouraged to take all five core courses" Grading: "All core and stats courses must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a grade of B- or better."

9Ppu2Tct.why: Notes: "Students are required to take PSYCH 251 (Experimental Methods; 4 units) during their first year, and one additional statistics course by the end of their second year. Quantitative methods courses must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a grade of B- or better." The additional statistics course is not listed, so it is moved in by hand.

children.name: One additional statistics course (letter grade, B- or better)

NeMghXFU.why: "Students must complete 12 units of advanced graduate coursework, referred to as advanced units (AU) ... A student may complete a PhD minor in another department instead of the advanced units requirement." Which courses are comparable is decided with the advisor, so the student moves them in (or marks the minor).

v9mSs8uO.why: "All students are required to complete at least five quarters of teaching experience by the end of their 5th year in the program ... Of these five teaching quarters, students are required to teach in two service courses."

patch.name: Five quarters of teaching (two in service courses)
